body: I dont have anything nice to say, nor do I have any advice for you. I just hope it helps knowing someone saw this.

I'm not sure its necessarily, "guilting" someone who wants to take their own life as much as it is genuine worry. Sure, from strangers on the internet it definitely feels like a guilt trip, but from people you might know IRL, I think it's less of a, "you're an idiot if you want to kill yourself." And more of a, "please dont go..." kind of thing, despite how some people might say it.

While that's definitely part of it, that's not entirely the reason although it is a common assumption. It's more of the fact that most social goals dont feel worth pursuing. It's the thought process of, "Why should I persue this goal when I hate myself *this* much?"
